title: Zid-An Haras
summary: Zid-An Haras is an Arcane Enhancement for Tektolyst Artifacts that increases Ammo Efficiency for all Warframe weapons and Amps on Tauron Strike.
extract:
Zid-An Haras is an Arcane Enhancement for Tektolyst Artifacts that increases Ammo Efficiency for all Warframe weapons and Amps on Tauron Strike.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Marie for a randomly determined amount of Perita resources in her rotating shop.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The Amp Ammo Efficiency bonus is always active.
Primary weapon ammo efficiency is additive to ammo efficiency sources like  Primary Compression.
